Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

shinyCRUK 0.6.0

New functions

  • crukKeyStatBox() adds a bordered box containing a key statement and, optionally, an image.
    • statement accepts a single character string, or a Shiny output such as textOutput() or uiOutput(), so the statement can be reactive.
    • image is optional. It takes the file name of an image in the app’s www folder and displays it at 140px by 140px. It is treated as decorative (alt = "").
    • The layout responds to the width of the box rather than the width of the page (a CSS container query). The image sits to the left of the statement when there is room, and above it otherwise.

Changes to crukChartTable()

Breaking changes

  • dataSourceText is now the displayed text, and dataSourceLink is the URL the user goes to when they click on it. The URL is no longer displayed. Previously, unless the link was a shinyapps.io URL ending in #, the URL was printed after the source text.

New features

  • dataSourceText and dataSourceLink are now optional. If neither is supplied, no source line is added and the words “Data source” do not appear. If only dataSourceText is supplied, it is shown as plain text without a link. If dataSourceLink is supplied without dataSourceText, it is ignored with a warning.
  • dataSourceLink now accepts shiny::textOutput() and shiny::uiOutput() as well as a character string, so the link can be reactive. The rendered value is used as the destination of the link and is not displayed. Only http(s):// URLs are used.
  • A top-level div supplied as dataSourceText (the default for textOutput() and uiOutput()) is now converted to a span, so it stays on the same line as the “Data source:” label.

Bug fixes

  • The data source line is now sized to its full text in crukChartTable.css, so “Data source: …” no longer wraps onto two lines.
  • Alt text over 125 characters now gives a warning instead of an error. Alt text under 15 characters, or empty, still errors.
  • Documentation: fixed the “Title” tab typo (now “Table”) and a stray #' in the examples.

shinyCRUK 0.5.1

  • crukTable() gains WindowSize, mobileBreakpoint and mobileMaxWidth arguments. Pass the reactive from window_size_server() to draw a compact table (smaller fonts, padding and column widths) on narrow screens.
  • crukChartTable() now fills its container’s width, and content that is too wide scrolls horizontally inside the card instead of widening the page.
  • centralColumn(): on screens under 992px, one wide child (e.g. a table) no longer stretches the whole column, and the page, past the screen edge.
  • crukTitle()’ subtitle now resizes properly on mobile.

shinyCRUK 0.5.0

  • New crukTooltip() function, a tooltip based on the Helix design system’s Popover

shinyCRUK 0.4.0

New features

  • New crukTable() family of functions, built as a wrapper around reactable::reactable().
    • crukTable() creates a styled table that can be used outside of shiny (eg. in RMarkdown or Quarto docs)
      • renderCrukTable() renders a crukTable() in a reactive environment so allowing the user to pass reactive variables
      • crukTableOutput() is a matching output function for renderCrukTable()
  • New crukDownloadButton(), a CRUK-styled wrapper around shiny::downloadButton(). Like crukButton(), it takes type ("primary" or "secondary") and an optional Material Symbols icon.

Bug fixes

  • crukChartTable(): dataSourceText now accepts shiny::textOutput() or shiny::uiOutput(), so the data source label can update reactively. Previously, tag objects were converted to a string and showed as raw markup.
